sections.title: Unit 17: The Visegrád Group (V4), Regional Alliances & European Cohesion
body: The Visegrád Group (Hungary, Poland, Czechia, Slovakia) embodies Central Europe's quest for regional weight, infrastructure integration, and diplomatic leverage within the European Union.

Through five case studies (the 1335 royal meeting, the 1991 declaration, north-south energy and transport corridors, the split over the war in Ukraine, and the Three Seas Initiative) you will practise formal Hungarian for describing diplomacy.
